frozen_internal_profile.note: Derived from canonical Frozen repository file only; no external per-security lookups.

GICS.official_structure: Four tiers; 11 Sectors, 25 Industry Groups, 74 Industries, 163 Sub-Industries; 8-digit hierarchical codes; current methodology April 2026.
GICS.official_bulk_route: S&P Global GICS dataset / GICS Direct; current global company classifications; delivery channels include API, Cloud, Feed and SFTP; MSCI Data Explorer also describes a security-level GICS Direct module.
GICS.coverage_public_claim: GICS Direct current classifications for over 50,000 active public companies in over 120 countries.
GICS.access_reason: Official materials describe licensed/subscription products and state restrictions on reproduction, distribution and database/retrieval-system storage absent permission. No project-specific GICS entitlement or written persistence/redistribution permission is present in repository authority.

ICB.official_structure: Four tiers: Industry, Supersector, Sector, Subsector; 11 Industries, 20 Supersectors, 45 Sectors, 173 Subsectors; coded taxonomy and current Ground Rules.
ICB.official_bulk_route: ICB Universe weekly files for roughly 85,000 equity securities globally plus daily update files; official index constituent files also carry ICB classifications.
ICB.coverage_public_claim: Approximately 85,000 equity securities, over 80 countries, 150 active exchanges; coverage extends beyond FTSE Russell equity index universe.
ICB.access_reason: Official ICB materials state use/distribution requires licence and no further distribution without express written consent; public materials do not establish project-specific permission to persist a full mapping in this repository.
